description: This file implements a Lua C module for uline, a command-line interface library, providing functions for managing line input, window size, key input, and event handling, with integration to the uloop event loop.

methods.name: registry_set
methods.description: Sets a value in the uline registry array, returning its index.

methods.name: uc_uline_poll
methods.description: Polls for new input line from uline state.

methods.name: uc_uline_poll_key
methods.description: Checks for a key press with optional timeout.

methods.name: uc_uline_poll_stop
methods.description: Stops polling for input.

methods.name: uc_uline_get_window
methods.description: Returns current window size as an object.

methods.name: uc_uline_get_line
methods.description: Retrieves the current input line and position.

methods.name: uc_uline_set_state
methods.description: Sets the internal state of the uline input.

methods.name: uc_uline_set_hint
methods.description: Sets a hint string for the input.

methods.name: uc_uline_set_uloop
methods.description: Associates a callback with the uloop event loop.

methods.name: uc_uline_reset_key_input
methods.description: Resets the key input mask.

methods.name: uc_uline_hide_prompt
methods.description: Hides the prompt.

methods.name: uc_uline_refresh_prompt
methods.description: Refreshes the prompt display.

methods.name: uc_uline_new
methods.description: Creates a new uline input resource with configuration.

methods.name: free_state
methods.description: Frees the uline state and cleans up.

methods.name: uc_uline_close
methods.description: Closes and frees the uline resource.

methods.name: skip_space
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters in a string.

methods.name: add_str
methods.description: Adds a substring to a string buffer.

methods.name: uc_uline_add_pos
methods.description: Adds start and end positions to a list.

methods.name: uc_uline_parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line style arguments from a string.

methods.name: uc_uline_arg_parser
methods.description: Creates an argument parser resource.

methods.name: uc_uline_argp_parse
methods.description: Parses arguments using the argument parser.

methods.name: uc_uline_argp_check
methods.description: Checks argument syntax.

methods.name: uc_uline_argp_escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for command-line.

methods.name: uc_uline_getpass
methods.description: Prompts for a password input.
